name: Biratori (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Biratori town emblem in green, blue and red: a green wreath of leaves with three stars around a blue ring enclosing a red device.
history: Municipal flag of Biratori, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 July 1949.

features.role: Biratori town emblem — a green wreath of leaves with three stars around a blue ring enclosing a red device
